thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 12/19/2018: JBL, MU, BB, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 12/19/2018: JBL, MU, BB, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.27%
AAPL: +0.1%
IBM: +0.31%
CSCO: +0.20%
GOOG: +0.42%
Technology stocks were edging higher pre-bell Wednesday.
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Jabil Circuit ( JBL ), which was advancing by more than 10% as its adjusted core EPS rose to $0.90 in Q1 from $0.80 a year earlier, beating analysts' estimates of $0.88 in a Capital IQ poll.
(-) Micron Technology ( MU ) was lower by more than 7% as the company issued a lower-than-expected revenue and earnings forecast for its fiscal second quarter on Tuesday and first-quarter sales missed the market's consensus.
In other sector news:
(+) BlackBerry ( BB ) was up more than 1% as analysts expect the company to post fiscal Q3 adjusted earnings per share that are even with the year-earlier period, as revenue is expected to be lower on a year-over-year basis when the communication-technology company releases the results Thursday morning.
